searchDocs.title: parse​
searchDocs.content: </> CarrotCore.parse(version: string) → Version Parses a version string, and deconstructs it into a format usable with the framework.

searchDocs.title: satisfies​
searchDocs.content: </> CarrotCore.satisfies( version: ConvertibleVersion, requirement: string ) → boolean Checks if a specific version fits a semver range requirement

searchDocs.title: format​
searchDocs.content: </> CarrotCore.format(version: Version) → string Reconstructs a Version table back into a semver string

searchDocs.title: Range​
searchDocs.content: </> type Range = { lo: Version, hi: Version?, source: string } Abstracted datatype that represents a deconstructed range, including a low & high (if provided) version, and the source string it came from.

searchDocs.title: Version​
searchDocs.content: </> type Version = { major: number, minor: number, patch: number } Primitive datatype that represents a deconstructed version, split up into their respective components.

searchDocs.title: ConvertibleVersion​
searchDocs.content: </> type ConvertibleVersion = Version | string Abstracted datatype allowing you to either pass a deconstructed Version, or a semver string that will then be deconstructed.

searchDocs.title: FromString​
searchDocs.content: </> VersionApi.FromString(version: string) → Version Translates a semver string into a Version object. Places that are held by a wildcard (*, X, x), or cut off as a partial, will be replaced with zeros. Example: VersionApi.FromString("1.2.3") --> {major = 1, minor = 2, patch = 3} VersionApi.FromString("1.2") --> {major = 1, minor = 2, patch = 0} | (Partial) VersionApi.FromString("1.X.x") --> {major = 1, minor = 0, patch = 0} | (Wildcard) VersionApi.FromString("1.*") --> {major = 1, minor = 0, patch = 0} | (Wildcard)

searchDocs.title: ToString​
searchDocs.content: </> VersionApi.ToString(version: Version) → string Translates a Version object into a semver string. Example: local version_a = VersionApi.FromString("1.2.4") local version_b = VersionApi.FromString("2.*") Version.ToString(version_a) --> "1.2.4" Version.ToString(version_b) --> "2.0.0"
